verdict.seen: A stove box with a gas pipe; the first frame shows no flame, then a yellow flame lights above the pipe in the later frames.
A yellow flame in the stove with black soot balls rising above it across the frames, plus a SOOTY label.
A yellow sooty flame in the first frame, then a burner tube with a black cap appears, and the flame turns blue in the last frame.
A close-up with a yellow rectangular outline around the tube and lower part of the burner. The blue flame and burner head sit outside the outline.
verdict.problem: The outline covers only part of the burner and misses the head and flame. Redraw it to trace the whole burner.

verdict.seen: White arrows and small air dots stream in toward the tube holes from both sides while the blue burner sits on top.
The blue flame is present in the first frame, then goes out; a draft arrow appears and green gas balls drift up with a GAS LEAK label.
Gas balls are present in the first frame; then a blue thermocouple wire with a red probe appears and the gas balls and flame are gone, with the valve shut.
The stove is clearly in view with its burner, and a yellow flame cluster flashes on top in the middle frame.
The stove is in view with a blue flame and a sign counting up from 1,000 to 1,950.
A grate and a pot appear over the blue flame on the stove top; the stove stands on the floor.
The whole finished stove with pot and grate is in view, and the camera pulls back with nothing covering it.
